_readme: Local-language copy for the bilingual city x niche pages.
APPROACH: pages are bilingual on a SINGLE url - local language first (the
page's primary language, set on <html lang>), then a clearly delimited
English block. This avoids a parallel translated url tree and the
scaled-machine-translation risk that comes with it.
These are NOT translations of the English copy. Each language leads with a
different angle chosen for that market (e.g. German leads on DSGVO and
Terminausfälle, French on the standard téléphonique, Dutch on bereikbaarheid).
STATUS: machine-generated, reviewed: false. A human reviews case by case;
when a correction is needed it is made here and the page is rebuilt.
Set reviewed: true per language once a native speaker has signed it off.
{city} is replaced with the city's local name where one exists
(München, Genève, Milano...), otherwise its English name.
Languages without an entry here render English-only - that is the intended
graceful degradation, not a bug. Currently missing: sv, da, fi, no, pl, cs,
et, lt, lv, pt, is (one city each).
